about_the_game:
"This is where the boundaries between reality and simulation melt."
Runway 66 is a psychological horror-adventure experience that follows the mental struggle of Subject 66, who is stranded in an abandoned airport as part of a government experiment. In this simulation filled with memories of the passengers who died in the crash, you must find the black box and solve the secrets of reality to escape the trap of the artificial intelligence Meryem.

🎮 Basic Features

  • Dynamic AI System:

    • Artificial intelligence Meryem adapts to the player's mistakes and progress speed turns aggressive accordingly. Turns off the lights, sends away ghost passengers.

  • Multiple Endings:

    • Encounter 3 different endings

  • Optimized Map Design:

    • The vast airport is divided into 3 main sectors: Infirmary, terminal, and runway. Different horror themes and puzzles in each section.

  • Atmospheric Horror:

    • A world full of foggy tracks, glitch-effect corridors, and momentary time shifts.

🌌 Story and Concept

  • Beginning: Your comatose body wakes up in the simulation as Subject 66. Last thing you remember: "Find the black box, or you're here forever."

  • Inside the Simulation: The terminal shops, plane wreckage, and foggy runway are overflowing with Meryem's manipulations.

  • Antagonist: AI Meryem was derived from the consciousness of a stewardess who died in the 1966 crash. Its goal is to trap all test subjects in the simulation.

📢 Why Runway 66?

  • Strengths:

    • Deep Lore: Every object in the terminal (suitcase, announcement recordings) adds a clue to the story.

    • Performance Friendly: Thanks to the modular design, the large map works smoothly even on low-end systems.

"Remember: Terminal 66 exists because you forgot."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A mind trapped in a looping simulation. A black box holding the truth. Experience psychological horror where your voice bends reality and memories lie.
